description: Erection of a two storey side infill and rear extension to the house, raising of existing roof ridge and enlargement of existing rear roof extension
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawing 03 received: 30/09/2019. 01 Rev A and 02 Rev A received: 14/10/2019. Site Location Plan, 04 Rev C, and 06 Rev B received: 15/11/2019. 07 Rev A received: 19/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
